_about: Every data source Live World Map reads, once: the coverage matrix on the Status tab, the 'where you are' lines and docs/COVERAGE.md are all made from this file (livemap-helper coverage). docs/SOURCES.md has the per-feed detail.

leads.minutes: minutes after the event or the warning

sources.name: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program
sources.gives: events, magnitude, depth, tsunami flag
sources.note: Complete for M4.5+ worldwide; below that, US-centred

sources.name: EMSC-CSEM real-time catalogue
sources.gives: the national networks' reports: smaller quakes outside the US, minutes after

sources.name: Pacific Tsunami Warning Center (tsunami.gov)
sources.gives: evaluations, watches, advisories, warnings and threat messages; threatened coast
sources.attribution: NOAA / NWS Pacific Tsunami Warning Center
sources.note: The Pacific and the Caribbean in full; threat messages for the Indian Ocean and other basins

sources.name: National Tsunami Warning Center (tsunami.gov)
sources.gives: watches, advisories, warnings for the US and Canadian coasts
sources.attribution: NOAA / NWS National Tsunami Warning Center

sources.name: GDACS tropical cyclones
sources.gives: events rated on humanitarian impact (green / orange / red), episode track and cone
sources.note: Lists a storm once it rates the impact; its wind is the episode peak

sources.name: NOAA National Hurricane Center
sources.gives: wind now, best track with winds, forecast with winds, cone

sources.name: Joint Typhoon Warning Center
sources.gives: wind now, forecast with winds; best track via UCAR's ATCF mirror
sources.licence: US public domain (JTWC); UCAR terms of service for the decks
sources.attribution: Joint Typhoon Warning Center; NCAR/UCAR TC guidance
sources.note: Western Pacific, Indian Ocean, southern hemisphere

sources.name: GDACS floods
sources.gives: flood events rated on people exposed, affected districts, Sendai figures

sources.name: NWS flood alerts (api.weather.gov)
sources.gives: official flash flood and flood warnings, watches and advisories with counties and polygons

sources.name: MeteoAlarm (EUMETNET)
sources.gives: official flood, rain and coastal warnings of 38 European weather services, by region
sources.attribution: MeteoAlarm, data provided by EUMETNET members
sources.note: No geometry in the feed: regions are placed on Natural Earth's admin-1 units by name, the country's centre as the fallback

sources.name: Environment and Climate Change Canada (GeoMet)
sources.gives: rainfall and flood warnings, watches and statements with polygons

sources.name: Environment Agency flood warnings
sources.gives: flood alerts, warnings and severe warnings for England with each flood area's outline
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3 (attribution line required)
sources.attribution: This uses Environment Agency flood and river level data from the real-time data API (Beta)
sources.note: England only; not for safety-critical use, says the Agency

sources.name: GDACS wildfires
sources.gives: wildfire events by alert level

sources.name: NIFC interagency perimeters
sources.gives: named incidents with size, containment, personnel, mapped perimeter

sources.name: CWFIS active fires
sources.gives: agency fires with stage of control, satellite perimeter estimates
sources.attribution: Natural Resources Canada, Canadian Wildland Fire Information System

sources.name: EFFIS burnt areas
sources.gives: burnt-area polygons of the last weeks with hectares
sources.note: Europe, the Middle East and North Africa

sources.name: NASA FIRMS hotspots (VIIRS)
sources.gives: raw satellite fire detections, clustered and rated (off by default)

sources.name: Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program
sources.gives: the weekly activity report and the eruption database (erupting since)
sources.cadence: hourly look at a weekly report
sources.note: A new eruption can take days to appear

sources.name: USGS volcano alert levels (HANS)
sources.gives: official alert levels and colour codes
sources.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey Volcano Hazards Program
sources.note: US volcanoes only (Alaska, Hawaii, Cascades, Yellowstone, Marianas)

sources.name: Ukraine air raid alerts (alerts.in.ua / mirror)
sources.gives: civil alert status per oblast (raion with a token)
sources.note: Off by default; a community relay of the official sirens

sources.name: The Space Devs, Launch Library 2
sources.gives: upcoming launches with pad, provider, mission, webcast

sources.name: CelesTrak orbital elements
sources.gives: ISS, Hubble and Tiangong elements, propagated locally
sources.cadence: every 6 h (one download per update, as CelesTrak asks)

sources.name: Live cloud maps (Matt Eason; GIBS / EUMETView fallback)
sources.gives: global cloud mask every 3 h
sources.licence: live-cloud-maps (EUMETSAT imagery); NASA GIBS and EUMETSAT terms for the stitched fallback
sources.attribution: Matt Eason's live cloud maps; NASA GIBS; EUMETSAT

sources.name: NASA Blue Marble, Black Marble, GIBS
sources.gives: monthly basemaps, night lights, today's satellite view

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.gives: coast, borders, rivers, lakes, names, places, time zones

sources.name: PB2002 plate boundaries
sources.gives: tectonic plate boundaries
sources.licence: ODC-By (Hugo Ahlenius / Nordpil, after Peter Bird 2003)
